title: Surreal Hotel California Dream
description: A surreal night scene features a glowing purple Hotel California building with a dragon coiled around it under a starry sky with a comet. In the foreground, a hiker with a backpack stands on a winding path by a river, looking toward a large crystal ball containing four expressive faces, surrounded by mountains, crystals, and floating hearts.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night landscape with a large glowing purple Hotel California building on a hill, a Chinese dragon coiled around the structure with its head above the roof, starry sky with a comet and constellations, winding luminous river path through mountains and purple vegetation, a backpacker hiker standing on the path holding a walking stick, large ornate crystal ball in the center containing four expressive human faces, scattered glowing crystals and floating hearts, intricate black and white line art with purple and lavender coloring, mystical and dreamy atmosphere
